meeting.title: Meetings
meeting.subtitle: Capture a meeting one line at a time, then decide what each line becomes.
meeting.attendeesHint: Tap a teammate, or type anyone else who is in the room.
meeting.emptyHint: Start one and type as the room talks. Every line is saved the moment you press Enter.
meeting.loadFailed: The meeting list could not be loaded.
meeting.hintEnter: Enter files a line for triage · Shift + Enter files it as a note · Esc clears the box
meeting.capturedNoneHint: Type the first thing anyone says. Each line is saved as you type it, so a closed tab loses nothing.
meeting.lineQueued: Saved on this device — it will sync when you are back online.
meeting.errAppend: That line was not saved. It is still in the box: press Enter to try again.
meeting.endConfirmBody: You go straight to triage, and you can reopen the meeting if the room keeps talking. Nothing is deleted.
meeting.notesPlaceholder: Anything the lines above do not cover.
meeting.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted, or the link may be wrong.
meeting.loadLinesFailed: This meeting's lines could not be loaded.
meeting.triageSubtitle: Decide what each line becomes. Nothing is deleted — a discarded line stays in the record.
meeting.fillDownLabel: Copy this row's ⁨{column}⁩ to every selected line below
meeting.discardedKept: Discarded lines stay in the record and appear in the minutes.
meeting.commitEmpty: Choose at least one line to create.
meeting.nothingToTriageHint: Every line is now an entry, a note, or discarded. Reopen the meeting to add more.
meeting.errNotYours: Only whoever started this meeting can change it.
meeting.errLineGone: That line is no longer part of this meeting.
meeting.errNoTitle: That line has no title, so there is nothing to create.
meeting.errLink: The entry was created, but its line was not marked. Check it before creating again.
meeting.errCommitOffline: Creating entries needs a connection. Your triage is saved and waiting.
meeting.errCommitBusy: Entries are already being created from this meeting.
